source: soil observations with Landsat, TerraClimate and terrain covariates
preparation: Landsat 7, 8 and 9 observations from 2014-2024; band alignment; cloud/shadow/snow masking; three-standard-deviation filtering; source LOWESS smoothing; 30-day interpolation; backward monthly climate join
obscuring: Fresh site IDs; coordinates and original IDs omitted. Landsat and climate numeric values multiplied by factors within 0.975-1.025; acquisition dates and QA flags retained. Terrain and carbon inherited from the earlier obscured sample: terrain offset by up to 3% of training standard deviation; carbon multiplied by a site-constant factor between 0.97 and 1.03; aspect perturbed before sine/cosine.
purpose: small teaching dataset derived from observations; no formal anonymity guarantee; not a scientific validation dataset
